source: avalanche_portal_package_2026-10-30 (analysis team), replacing the portal's earlier uncalibrated preview thresholds
method: Per-tile MODERATE/HIGH thresholds are each tile's own ERA5 winter percentile (57 winters), from best_rules.csv's STORM / WARM-SNOW rule: MODERATE = 3-day snowfall >=P95 (>=10mm) and 3-day gust >=P95, or 3-day Tmax rise >=P95 and 7-day snowfall >=P90 (>=20mm) with a snowpack; HIGH = 3-day snowfall >=P99 (>=25mm) and 3-day gust >=P90, or the same warm-snow test at HIGH thresholds.

validation.source: forecast/data/final_rule_validation.csv (documented historical avalanche events and storms, step 7 of the pipeline)

student_model: forecast/data/student.joblib + percentile_tables.parquet: an experimental ML risk score (student_risk, 0-1), shown as secondary information only, not the alert level itself.
note: Real, calibrated thresholds (not a preview). To update when the analysis team sends a new data/ folder: replace this folder's contents and keep config/ and output/ as they are -- no code change needed.
